settings.title: Presentations
settings.description: Nomi uses the built-in ppt-master Skill to make PPT decks. Flowy downloads and manages it with a private Python environment that does not touch any other Python on your computer.
settings.notInstalledHint: Nomi installs it automatically the first time you ask for a deck, or you can install it now. About {{size}} to download.

actions.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall ppt-master and its Python environment? It is downloaded again the next time you make a deck.

notice.installing: Installing the presentation capability (ppt-master). Nomi continues the deck once it is ready.

home.label: Slides
home.slashDescription: Make a slide deck (ppt-master): pick canvas, length and pace
home.placeholder: Describe your deck, e.g. quarterly business review for leadership

create.title: Create a presentation
create.importHint: Pick a PPTX, PDF or image as a reference. Nomi turns it into a template first, then makes this deck with it
create.importedHint: Imported template: after you send, Nomi first creates a template from this file

weeklyStatus.title: Automate a weekly team status report
weeklyStatus.prompt: Make a weekly team status report: progress this week, key metrics, risks and next week's plan, for the department head

salesDashboard.title: Build a quarterly sales performance dashboard
salesDashboard.prompt: Make a quarterly sales performance review: revenue and attainment, region and product comparison, key accounts, plan for next quarter

competitors.title: Analyze competitors and positioning
competitors.prompt: Make a competitor analysis: main competitors, market share, product and pricing comparison, our differentiated positioning and recommendations

productLaunch.title: Launch a new product
productLaunch.prompt: Make a product launch deck: user pain points, product highlights, core feature walkthrough, pricing and go-to-market plan

fundraising.title: Prepare a fundraising pitch
fundraising.prompt: Make a fundraising pitch deck: problem and opportunity, product, business model, traction, team, the raise and use of funds

architecture.title: Explain a system architecture
architecture.prompt: Make a technical architecture talk: overall architecture, core modules and data flow, key trade-offs, roadmap

onboarding.title: Design new-hire onboarding
onboarding.prompt: Make a new-hire onboarding deck: company intro, org structure, workflows, common tools and the first-week plan

postmortem.title: Review a production incident
postmortem.prompt: Make a blameless incident postmortem: impact, timeline, root cause, response and follow-up actions

explainer.title: Explain a complex idea simply
explainer.prompt: Make an explainer deck that uses plain analogies to show how large language models work, for a non-technical audience
